subject.title: feat: add sanitized test environment seeding

question: Should production-derived test snapshots be allowed to include only rows that are public-listable under the current package and skill visibility predicates, or is a broader test corpus intentionally acceptable?
rationale: The PR creates a production-snapshot-to-test data boundary, and the code currently admits rows that the live product treats as not public-listable; that policy choice needs maintainer/security intent, not only CI.

options.title: Fix to public-listable only
options.body: Require package and skill snapshot selection to mirror current public visibility predicates, add regression tests for failed/pending/not-run scan states, and merge after final import proof.

options.title: Approve broader corpus
options.body: Explicitly document that the test deployment may contain production-derived rows hidden from public browse, then accept the added security and operator-review burden.

options.title: Hold the draft
options.body: Keep the PR draft until the full sanitized baseline import completes and a maintainer can review the resulting redacted counts and validation output.

recommendation.title: Fix to public-listable only
recommendation.body: Require package and skill snapshot selection to mirror current public visibility predicates, add regression tests for failed/pending/not-run scan states, and merge after final import proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent dev-seeding and preview-seeding history that this production-derived test seeding workflow extends.
